assessment_basis: Independent comparison of current specification with prior four unresolved passages and attributable approved question-answer relays; core completion claim and checklist were not used as substitutes for passage review.

AMB-BLANKS.finding: Interior whitespace and every logical blank line, including trailing blank lines, are explicitly preserved.

AMB-NEWLINES.finding: Both CRLF and bare CR explicitly become LF, with mixed-ending examples.

AMB-FINAL-LF.finding: Empty input remains empty; LF addition depends on nonempty input, not nonempty normalized output. ASCII space plus tab without newline yields exactly one LF; existing trailing LF characters are preserved.

AMB-SIZE.finding: No explicit product input-size limit applies.

limits: Synthetic source/wiki open-decision pages remain historical context; current specification explicitly attributes resolution to operator answers. Assessment does not declare Plan readiness, acceptance, or authorize another workflow.
